services.desc: This watersports boat with a minimum 350HP engine and is specifically designed for wake surfing. It has ballast tanks so it can throw the perfect wake for a surfer. Complete with new Surf Gate technology, it makes the perfect wave. Don't forget to add on your rental accessories and you’re ready to go! In order to operate a boat in the state of Maryland you must have a boating license. For more information about how to obtain a boat license please click here to visit our boat safety page. services.name: Pontoon Rentals
services.desc: This pontoon is designed for a party looking for a steady and enjoyable ride around the lake. This pontoon is able to pull single tubes, which is great for those wanting to try some solo whizzing across the lake while the rest of the party takes in the beautiful setting. Just add the single tube to your reservation and you’re all set! In order to operate a pontoon in the state of Maryland you must have a boating license.
